doc.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The family quartet
summary: Scott, Kenneth, Nadine and Adore sing as the family quartet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So it just kind of came sort of naturally that you and your brothers and sisters got together, gathered around the piano . . .
That’s right. There were four of us that were the family quartet. That was Kenneth, my brother, younger than I; Nadine; and Adoré.
That was the quartet in the family.
